title: Data for RegulaTome: a corpus of typed, directed, and signed relations between biomedical entities
author: Nastou, Katerina

steps.title: Set up resources and files
steps.instruction: Download and extract all required resources: the RegulaTome corpus in BRAT format, the "splits" directory, annotation guidelines (annodoc+config.tar.gz), the tagger software from its GitHub repository, the dictionary archive (tagger_dictionary_files.tar.gz), and the relation‑extraction model archives (relation_extraction_multi-label-best_model.tar.gz and the RoBERTa‑large‑PM‑M3‑Voc model).

steps.title: Run tagger on corpus
steps.instruction: Execute the tagger command to process the PMC and PubMed TSV files and produce a matches file.

substeps.instruction: Decompress and list all PMC files matching pmc/*.en.merged.filtered.tsv.gz and all PubMed files matching pubmed/*.tsv.gz using `gzip -cd` and `ls -1`.
Concatenate the list of excluded documents (dictionary/excluded_documents.txt) with the decompressed streams via `cat`.

Pipe the combined stream into `tagger/tagcorpus` with the following options: `--threads=16 --autodetect --types=dictionary/curated_types.tsv --entities=dictionary/all_entities.tsv --names=dictionary/all_names_textmining.tsv --groups=dictionary/all_groups.tsv --stopwords=dictionary/all_global.tsv --local-stopwords=dictionary/all_local.tsv --type-pairs=dictionary/all_type_pairs.tsv --out-matches=all_matches.tsv`.

steps.title: Convert BioC to tab‑delimited format
steps.instruction: Obtain the full‑scale input documents (entire PubMed as of March 2024 and PMC Open Access as of November 2023) in BioC format and convert them to a tab‑delimited format compatible with the relation‑extraction system.

steps.title: Filter tagger output for gene/protein hits
steps.instruction: From the tagger output (all_matches.tsv), keep only gene/protein matches and retain only those documents that contain more than one hit; compress the filtered table to tagger_matches_ggp_only_gt_1_hit.tsv.gz.

steps.title: Create standoff files for RE input
steps.instruction: Run the `tagger2standoff.py` script from the string‑db‑tools repository on the filtered TSV (tagger_matches_ggp_only_gt_1_hit.tsv.gz) to generate the .ann and .txt files required by the relation‑extraction pipeline; the resulting directories are packaged in combined_input_for_re.tar.gz.

steps.title: Execute relation extraction and retrieve results
steps.instruction: Run the relation‑extraction system using the provided Transformer‑based model (relation_extraction_multi-label-best_model.tar.gz) together with the pre‑trained RoBERTa‑large‑PM‑M3‑Voc model; the system writes tab‑delimited output files (86 columns: PMID, Entity BRAT ID1, Entity BRAT ID2, and per‑class scores) into the archive large_scale_relation_extraction_results.tar.gz (≈ 1 TB).
